format: BUFR (PrepBUFR cycle file + GPS-RO BUFR dump), decoded with earth2bufr
notes: HealDAv2 reads prepbufr (u,v,q,t,pres) and gpsro (gps,gps_refractivity) from this source = 7 variables, which is also the full NNJAObsConvLexicon VOCAB (utils_ncep.py:715-716).

Deviation from the model: HealDAv2 uses layout='wide' in TWO calls (one per stream); wide rejects mixing PrepBUFR and GPS-RO variables in one call (utils_ncep.py:920), so the single generic call here uses the default layout='long'. Same files downloaded and decoded; output frame shape differs.

HealDAv2 reads [t-45h, t+3h] (8 six-hourly frames, +-3h each; example :107). The harness cannot express an asymmetric tuple tolerance, so time_tolerance_hours=3 benchmarks ONE frame of the window; a real model init is ~8x this.
original_event / exclude_message_types as in the example (:109-115). Time is the example's analysis time; MIN_DATE 1979-01-01 (nnja.py:321).
